description: Test cases for competitor discovery skill — validates source scanning, entity extraction, and fuzzy matching accuracy

evals.prompt: Run a discovery scan on mining.com, mining-weekly.com, and discoveryalert.com.au. Extract all mentions of AI startups, mining companies, and funding announcements from the past 7 days. Return structured JSON with company names, websites, signals, and source URLs.
evals.expected_output: JSON with 5-15 new_competitors, each with name, website, signals array, and source_url

evals.prompt: Given the existing company list (Terra AI, GeologicAI, Fleet Space, Stratum AI), perform a discovery scan of mining.com and LinkedIn for 'mining AI' companies. For any mentions that fuzzy-match (>0.85 confidence) to existing companies, classify as 'existing_mention' and extract new signals. For no-match mentions, classify as 'new_candidate'. Return JSON with both categories separated.
evals.expected_output: JSON with 'existing_with_new_signals' array showing matches to known companies and 'new_competitors' array showing unmatched discoveries

evals.prompt: Scan LinkedIn, Crunchbase, and web search for investors and companies that have funded or partnered with mineral exploration AI startups. Identify: (1) venture capital firms specializing in mining/minerals, (2) corporate venture arms (BHP Ventures, Rio Tinto Ventures, etc.), (3) accelerators (Techstars, Y Combinator cohorts with mining companies). Return structured JSON with relationship_type marked as 'investor' and related_company links where applicable.
evals.expected_output: JSON with new_related_companies array showing VCs, corporate VCs, and accelerators with relationship types and fund sizes where available
